[This aptly named book contains information about the founding members of the Bounty Hunters’ Guild, including this crib sheet summary of the original figures who shaped the Guild’s legacy.]

Cradossk
A ruthless and cunning Trandoshan, Cradossk was the first recognized leader of the Bounty Hunters’ Guild, establishing its initial structure and code of conduct. He prioritized order among hunters, ensuring that the Guild operated as a respected institution rather than a chaotic collection of mercenaries. Under his leadership, the Guild expanded its influence, securing lucrative contracts with the Empire, the Hutts, and various planetary governments.

Gorba the Hutt
A prominent figure in Hutt Space, Gorba played a key role in legitimizing the Guild’s operations by brokering deals with the Hutt Cartels. Recognizing that an organized network of bounty hunters was far more useful than scattered freelancers, Gorba ensured that the Guild maintained steady employment, particularly in tracking down debtors and rivals for the Hutt clans.

Bossk
Son of Cradossk, Bossk was a feared hunter in his own right, known for his brutality and skill in Wookiee hunting. While he initially worked under his father’s leadership, he later challenged Cradossk for control of the Guild, leading to a violent power struggle that reshaped its hierarchy. His influence ensured that strength and reputation remained crucial within the Guild’s ranks.

Dengar
A Corellian bounty hunter with a reputation for resilience, Dengar was among the early members who helped establish the Guild’s training programs and recruitment structure. While not as feared as some of his counterparts, his knowledge of galactic underworld networks proved invaluable in securing contracts and expanding the Guild’s reach beyond Hutt Space.

Jango Fett (Honored Predecessor)
While not a direct founder, Jango Fett’s legacy loomed large over the Guild. His reputation as one of the greatest bounty hunters of his time influenced the Guild’s rise in prominence, particularly through his dealings with the Kaminoans and the rise of the Clone Army. Many within the Guild studied his tactics, and his name became synonymous with the ideals of efficiency and professionalism that the Guild sought to uphold.
